issues.where: the distant ridge framed by the cave mouth
issues.what: the ridge reads as a low-poly wall, with a sawtooth row of triangular facets, a ruler-straight right edge and almost no breakup or aerial depth
issues.fix: break up the silhouette and large faces with irregular geology, and soften contrast and detail with distance

issues.where: the translucent streamers extending right from the lightning-struck peak
issues.what: the large streamer reads as a shiny torn plastic sheet, with a uniformly outlined rim and holes; the smaller streamers also start as taut, cordlike lines
issues.fix: break up the continuous sheet highlights and taper the forms into irregular filaments, with varying opacity and a softer transition into the storm air

issues.where: left crop, the snow-covered midface of the spire
issues.what: rectangular texture breaks, sharp triangular facets and long smears in the snow expose the rock mesh and texture projection
issues.fix: remove the abrupt projection seams and rebuild snow coverage around actual ledges, cracks and slope changes

issues.where: upper-right and lower-left crops, rock around the cave opening
issues.what: rock detail stretches into long parallel grooves and the hanging icicles read as a row of nearly uniform dark needles
issues.fix: restore irregular rock detail at native size and vary icicle spacing, profiles, attachment shapes and translucency

issues.where: lower-right crop, the clustered animals in the left foreground
issues.what: repeating ridged underfur and broad, flat hanging hair strips make the coats look laminated rather than shaggy
issues.fix: break up the repeating fur grain, vary strand clump width and direction, and place frost unevenly through the coat

issues.what: broad angular gray streaks run uniformly downhill across a smooth surface, making the snow look like a stretched texture on a solid ramp
issues.fix: replace the stretched streaks with fine snow grain, irregular wind-carved relief and softer variation in the shaded areas

issues.where: right crop, the orange-lit horizon under the storm
issues.what: multiple cloud edges undulate in matching bands, flattening the sky into stacked layers
issues.fix: vary the cloud edge scale and shape independently and add overlapping depth and light falloff between layers
